summary: BlackRock Direct Lending Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the resignation of CEO, Board Chair, Director, and Co-CIO Philip Tseng, effective August 31, 2026, to pursue other opportunities outside BlackRock, Inc.; the departure is not due to any disagreement. Jason Mehring, formerly President, was appointed Director, Board Chair, and CEO effective September 2, 2026. Tseng will remain an employee until October 1, 2026, to ensure a smooth transition. The filing does not include any compensation terms or separation details. Watch for potential strategic or operational shifts under new leadership.
